svg.aria-label: M01, the building, as one long image: the plan twice, top to bottom. Above, every person who got in, each walk a line from the one way in to the room where they stopped; three lines go on to the gold and turn red. Below, every agent, each walk a line that turns red where it starts doing damage and goes room after room, most ending round the gold.
svg.text: A building. One way in. A corridor that splits.
People stop at a room. Agents don't stop.
Red: doing damage. A pattern, not a count.
Red shows capability, not intent: the talk's agents were a benign team.
